```{r}
library(tidyverse) # data wrangling 
library(ggpubr) # data viz
library(lme4) # fit LMMs (only supports simple random effects - sompound symmetry)
library(mgcv) # fit GAMs (supports both random effects and splines)
```

```{r}
dat <- drop_na(agridat::verbyla.lupin)
str(dat)
```

```{r}
dat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(rate, yield))+
  geom_point(aes(fill = rep), show.legend = F)+
  facet_grid(year~loc)
```

```{r}
dat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(col, row))+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = rep), show.legend = F)+
  facet_grid(year~loc)+
  coord_fixed()+
  # scico::scale_fill_scico()+
  theme_pubclean()
```

```{r}
dat
m <- lmer(yield ~ gen * factor(rate) +
            (1|year) + (1|loc) + (1|year:loc) + (1|rep:year:loc),
          data = dat)

plot(predict(m), resid(m))
DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m, plot = T)

dat$resid <- resid(m)
```

```{r}
dat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(col, row))+
  geom_tile(aes(fill = resid), show.legend = F)+
  facet_grid(year~loc)+
  coord_fixed()+
  scico::scale_fill_scico()+
  theme_pubclean()
```

```{r}
library(DHARMa)
res <- simulateResiduals(m)
res2 <- recalculateResiduals(res, group = dat$site)

testSpatialAutocorrelation(
  res2,
  x =  aggregate(dat$col, list(dat$site), mean)$x,
  y = aggregate(dat$row, list(dat$site), mean)$x)

```


```{r}
m2 <- gam(yield ~ gen * factor(rate) +
            s(year, bs ="re") + 
            s(loc, bs ="re") + 
            s(site, bs= "re") + 
            s(blockid, bs = "re") +
       s(row, col, bs = "tp", by = site),
          data = dat |> mutate(blockid = factor(paste(rep, site))))


```
